_note: Variant guides are simplified feature descriptions used in the AI prompt. In production they come from Cars24's catalogue.

variants.Smart: Steel wheels without covers; analogue instrument cluster; no touchscreen
variants.Pure: Steel wheels with covers; 7-inch touchscreen; analogue cluster
variants.Creative: 16-inch alloy wheels; 10.25-inch touchscreen; digital instrument cluster
variants.Creative+ Dark: All-black exterior with black alloy wheels; '#DARK' embroidered headrests; 10.25-inch touchscreen; digital cluster; RC classification often reads 'CRTV + DK'
variants.Fearless+: Diamond-cut alloy wheels; 12.3-inch touchscreen; ventilated seats; 360-degree camera

variants.LXI: Black steel wheels without covers; no music system; black door handles; halogen headlamps
variants.VXI: Steel wheels with full silver wheel covers; 2-DIN audio unit; body-coloured door handles
variants.ZXI: 15-inch silver alloy wheels; 2-DIN audio unit; rear 'ZXI' badge
variants.ZXI+: Two-tone diamond-cut alloy wheels; 7-inch touchscreen; LED projector headlamps
